summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing conditional preliminary approval from the OCC to establish a nationally chartered bank, Ita Bank, N.A., in the U.S. This is a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation. No deal terms, pricing, or transaction structure are involved. Final launch remains subject to Federal Reserve and FDIC approvals. The filing describes ordinary business expansion and has no M&A or capital markets implications, so it is classified as None.
